critical_code_review_comments: server.py:958-983 — CONTENT_FAV_TYPES whitelist prevents arbitrary item_type values; user_favorites collection is a good generic store. Toggle uses find_one + insert/delete (2 round-trips); acceptable for this scale.

server.py:986-1035 — /me/library correctly unions legacy (podcasts, programs) + generic (user_favorites for meditazioni/studi-biblici/predicazioni/video), passes docs through imageopt.lighten_list, and only appends groups with items>0. CMS routes point to '/c/{t}' (list), not the item detail — acceptable given library cards are horizontal chips; if you later want to deep-link into the item, switch to '/c/{t}/{id}'.
useContentFav.ts — clean optimistic toggle with revert on error; SetState of Set is fine because a fresh Set is constructed each toggle.

labels.ts — LABEL_CATALOG is exhaustive (Biblioteca cats + Profilo menu entries), and useLabel falls back to catalog defaults; SettingsContext.refresh() call after save propagates overrides live without a hard reload.
biblioteca.tsx:47 — favorite group title uses t(`cat_${g.key}`, g.label) so admin renames apply to both the fav group and the category card; nice.
profilo.tsx:95-101 — old 'Podcast preferiti' block is removed and replaced with a single go-library CTA — matches spec exactly.
Minor (informational, project-wide): RN-Web 'shadow*' / 'textShadow*' / 'props.pointerEvents' deprecation warnings still present — not introduced by this feature.
